title: NFA Backtracking Explosion vs Linear Match
description: Trace how nested quantifiers (a+)+ explore 2^n paths on mismatch while /u handles surrogate pairs.

steps.label: 1. Greedy Forward Scan
steps.description: Pattern /^(a+)+$/ consumes all 'a' characters in 'aaaaaaaaaa!' before hitting '!'.

steps.label: 2. Exponential Backtrack Cascade
steps.description: Every partition of the 10 'a's is retried in turn (2^10 = 1024 attempts; 30 'a's = 1 billion attempts).

steps.label: 3. Linear Non-Ambiguous Pattern + /u
steps.description: Rewriting to /^a+$/u removes nested quantifiers (O(n)) and decodes full Unicode code points.
